summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the final results of exchange offers where holders of $6.298 billion aggregate principal of unregistered Restricted Notes (series due 2028, 2038, 2040, 2041, 2049, 2051) tendered them for identical registered Exchange Notes. No new money or changed terms; the exchange solely provides registration rights under the Securities Act. The board did not offer a recommendation; the exchange agent was D.F. King. Settlement is July 13, 2026. This is a routine registration-exchange, not a special situation, with no premium, activism, or strategic change. No arbitrage angle exists as the securities are economically identical.
